payload.source: 'soundbox' | 'suggestion' — optional, 'soundbox' by default: the DM view's surface it is triggered from, the suggestion's pastille stored as origin 'pastille'; any other source (the player view's) is refused by dm-side-only
payload.session: uuid — optional: the session it plays in, of the sound's campaign; by default the campaign's live session, else its latest one not closed, else its latest
